label: TECHNICAL REPORT / DESIGN REFERENCE
title: A decision-ready view of the site
subtitle: A readable report format for findings, supporting evidence and practical next steps. This specimen demonstrates structure, not an actual site assessment.

sections.title: Executive finding
paragraphs: State the central finding in one concise paragraph. Explain its operational significance and the decision it supports. Separate measured results from estimates and unresolved questions.

rows: Describe the condition recorded during inspection.
Identify the work or investigation it supports.
State units, period, method and source.
Explain the result without overstating precision.
Identify the document and its revision.

sections.title: Recommendations
paragraphs: Prioritize the action supported by the evidence. Identify the inspection or document needed to resolve uncertainty. Assign responsibility and define the completion evidence.

sections.title: Limitations
paragraphs: State what the report did not evaluate and which conclusions depend on incomplete information. Keep limitations beside the findings they qualify, rather than hiding them in tiny print.
sections.note: Design specimen only. All example entries describe report-writing requirements; they are not findings about an Ocean project.
